stories.title: Five Israelis wounded as two suspected attackers killed in West Bank shooting
stories.summary: A shooting in the occupied West Bank wounded five Israelis and Israeli forces killed two suspected Palestinian attackers. The violence comes amid heightened tensions four days before Israel's general election.

stories.title: Sudan's RSF fighters deliberately targeted hospitals, BBC investigation finds
stories.summary: A BBC investigation found that RSF fighters deliberately attacked hospitals in Sudan. UN human rights chief Volker Türk said the multiple attacks may amount to war crimes.

stories.title: South Korea invites North to military talks over tense border
stories.summary: Seoul proposed military talks with Pyongyang days after North Korea said it had moved new units into "firing positions" along the border. The overture is a rare attempt to lower tension on the heavily armed frontier.

stories.title: Magnitude 7 earthquake in Tibet kills at least 16 and collapses hundreds of homes
stories.summary: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck China's Nagqu area in the Tibet Autonomous Region, a mountainous and sparsely populated region, killing at least 16 people. Rescuers are working through collapsed housing in remote villages.

stories.title: Hacking attempts rise after flaws found in software used by most of the web
stories.summary: Attack attempts are climbing after the disclosure of vulnerabilities in PHP, the server-side scripting language that underpins roughly 70 percent of websites. Defenders are racing to patch systems before exploitation broadens.

stories.title: Oura sues rival Ultrahuman again, threatening its U.S. smart ring comeback
stories.summary: Oura filed a new lawsuit alleging Ultrahuman's Ring Pro infringes two of its patents. The case complicates Ultrahuman's push back into the U.S. smart ring market.

stories.title: inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia
stories.summary: Uber rival inDrive plans to begin testing Pony.ai robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027, with Nvidia supplying compute. It marks an early push to bring autonomous ride-hailing to Central Asia.

stories.title: US tech stocks tumble as investors fret over AI spending
stories.summary: US technology shares dropped sharply as investors questioned whether massive capital spending on AI infrastructure can be sustained. The sell-off underscores how sensitive markets have become to AI capex guidance.

stories.title: Browns at Titans: storylines, scouting report and picks
stories.summary: Cleveland.com's Orange and Brown Talk previews Sunday's Browns trip to Tennessee, with Mary Kay Cabot, Ashley Bastock and Dan Labbe on storylines and Lance Reisland scouting the Titans.

stories.title: Browns' yards-after-catch production uneven but clutch when it counts
stories.summary: A third of the way into the season, Cleveland's receiving corps has been inconsistent after the catch but has delivered in key moments. The breakdown looks at where the YAC yards are coming from.

stories.title: Browns' pass rush thrives even as Jared Verse waits for his first sack
stories.summary: Jared Verse is sackless through six games but remains upbeat, and Cleveland's defense ranks second in the NFL with 19 sacks under new coordinator Mike Rutenberg. The production has come from a collective effort rather than one edge rusher.

stories.title: Quincy Williams sits out with neck injury, but two key defenders return to practice
stories.summary: Linebacker Quincy Williams missed Thursday's session with a neck injury, leaving his status for Sunday's game at Tennessee uncertain. Carson Schwesinger and Grant Delpit were back in limited practice.

stories.title: The Beat: Ohio State's quarterback situation overfills the mailbag
stories.summary: 10TV's Austin & Birm Show devoted Friday's mailbag to Ohio State's quarterback plans with Julian Sayin out indefinitely. The discussion centered on how the Buckeyes sort through options during the bye week.

stories.title: Skull Session: Ohio State still hasn't played its 'A' game this season
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors' Friday roundup argues the Buckeyes have yet to put together a complete performance in 2026. It also notes Jeremiah Smith was named an AP midseason All-American.

stories.title: Two more freshmen shed their black stripes at Ohio State
stories.summary: Favour Akih and Nick Lautar became the 13th and 14th Ohio State freshmen to have their black stripes removed in 2026. The tradition marks a freshman's transition into full standing with the program.

stories.title: Renault agrees to sell Viry-Châtillon F1 engine facility to Belgium's Dumarey Group
stories.summary: Renault has agreed to sell its Viry-Châtillon powertrain site to Dumarey Group, a Belgian engineering firm focused on powertrains and components. The deal closes a chapter on Renault's works engine operation in France.

stories.title: Norris says COTA bumps are so bad he takes headache tablets before driving
stories.summary: Lando Norris backed Max Verstappen's criticism of the Circuit of the Americas surface, saying he uses headache tablets before getting in the car. Verstappen had called the bumps "unacceptable" and "out of control" ahead of the U.S. Grand Prix.

stories.title: It's now Bearman versus Camara for the next Ferrari vacancy
stories.summary: Ferrari's succession planning has narrowed to Oliver Bearman and Rafael Camara as the two candidates for its next race seat. Timing and academy politics will decide which driver gets the opportunity.

stories.title: Two Ohio polls put Acton and Sherrod Brown ahead in statewide races
stories.summary: Two new Ohio polls show Democrats Amy Acton and Sherrod Brown leading their Republican opponents in the governor's and Senate races. Voters cited cost of living and President Trump's performance ahead of the Nov. 3 election.

stories.title: Columbus council weighs new rules after retention pond drownings
stories.summary: After a toddler drowned in a north Columbus retention pond, City Council held a hearing on legislation intended to prevent similar tragedies. Members reviewed local drowning statistics and proposals to improve warning and safety measures at ponds.

stories.title: New Albany data center power plant draws backers and critics at hearing
stories.summary: The Ohio Power Siting Board held a public hearing on a proposed power plant serving a data center in New Albany's business park. Residents, environmental advocates and business leaders split over the project.

stories.title: Columbus emergency shelter seeks new partners as YMCA tie-up ends
stories.summary: The Van Buren Center's partnership with the YMCA of Central Ohio is ending after more than a decade. The Community Shelter Board is looking for organizations to provide services at the emergency shelter.
